entities.name: David Kämpf
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: David Kämpf is a Czech professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Washington Capitals of the National Hockey League (NHL). He has previously played for the Chicago Blackhawks, Toronto Maple Leafs, and Vancouver Canucks. Internationally, Kämpf has represented the Czech Republic, contributing to a gold medal win at the 2024 World Championship.
